title: pleione glandulosa
intro: Pleione glandulosa, commonly known as Chinese ghost orchid, is a type of terrestrial orchid native to China and Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Pleione glandulosa include its potential to lower blood pressure, alleviate anxiety and depression, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as sedative and anti-inflammatory effects.
